name: Theming & Appearance Configuration
shortDesc: GUIs to configure GTK themes, Qt styles, cursor sizing, and fonts across all desktop toolkits.
detailedDesc: Ensures uniform dark mode, typography, and icon themes across both GTK and Qt software.

phase.title: Desktop QoL & Ricing Utilities
phase.description: The fine-grained ricing details: clipboard managers, color pickers, screenshot annotation, polkit, portals, and fonts.

packages.name: nwg-look (Recommended)
packages.description: GTK3/GTK4 settings editor designed specifically for Wayland compositors. Sets GTK themes, icon packs, cursors, and fonts without GNOME dependencies.
pros: Directly writes to xsettingsd and gsettings

packages.name: qt6ct + kvantum (Recommended)
packages.description: Qt6 configuration tool paired with Kvantum SVG theme engine to give Qt applications unified dark themes.
pros: Unifies Qt apps with GTK styling
Kvantum SVG engine enables custom blur and opacity
